name: AI Professions prompt benchmark
description: 100 prompts for real tasks in ten professions plus Excel / Microsoft 365 in English, Spanish, French and Brazilian Portuguese, run on 5 models x 3 runs and graded criterion by criterion by a cross-family LLM judge (1,500 runs, 7,500 verdicts). Rubrics were hash-locked before the first run. Includes every transcript, per-criterion verdicts, judge-swap calibration and spot-checks. Method: https://aiprofessions.ai/methodology/
